quality_summaries.basis: Nominal sequence-comparison rule conditional on ploidy, locus and reliable calls. Missing calls are not a third biological genotype.

ambiguities.issue: Physical genomic bearers, inheritance and molecular occurrences. Physical segment, information identity and function are distinct readings. Clinical classification and sequence databases are outside this gateway.
ambiguities.decision: Human category/namespace consolidation required; legacy compatibility is not sufficient reason to retain meanings.

ambiguities.issue: Many relevant parameter qualities and participant kinds lack current declarations.
ambiguities.decision: Open upstream issues. Parameters here describe relevant qualities, not ontology model inputs or equations.

ambiguities.issue: Bounded event versus ongoing process reading and object continuity.
ambiguities.decision: Review delimitation and identity; separate change resolution requires occurrent, never no-change inference.

ambiguities.issue: NHGRI explicitly notes debated gene definition and functional noncoding RNA genes.
ambiguities.decision: Keep physical segment separate from information identity and function; no one-gene-one-protein axiom.

ambiguities.issue: Generic root inheritance is not an additional scientific specialization.
ambiguities.decision: Keep foundational type reference separate from selected parent; seek meaningful imported context or explicit user-reviewed relaxation upstream. No redundant is declaration.

coverage.weak_source_areas: No expert interviews, systematic synthesis or assay-standard review. Introductory sources motivate vocabulary but do not establish all operational boundaries.
coverage.independent_holdout: None. Source-first order is retained; author had prior domain knowledge. Fresh expert probes required.
coverage.count_interpretation: Category counts are explored records, not validated coverage. The current imported-derivation gate blocks all records; conceptual scientific plausibility is separately recorded.
